title: Just ok
text: Just ok. This blender is a great no frills option. But that is about it. You get your basic manual 1-8 power with And few presets. The blades were sharp but it had a hard time making a smoothie flwith frozen fruit right from the freezer. Not sure how this would fare against cubes of ice. If you can score this for $50 or under I would say definitely grab it. But only if you are a casual when it comes to the smoothie game like me..... This is not for the smoothie bosses of the world.

product_metadata.title: Syvio Bullet Blender for Shakes and Smoothies, 600W Personal Blender, Smoothie Blender with 2 BPA-Free 20 Oz Sport Cup, 2 Party Mugs, 1 * 10 Oz short cup,Easy to Clean

【Easy to Use and Clean】Blender for smoothies is easy to use with one button operation. To clean, put clear water into the blender and turn it on. In addition, the smoothie maker can be easily cleaned in a dishwasher, except for the motor part.

【304 Stainless Blades and 5 Cups】Blender blade is made of 304 stainless steel, featuring a 4-blade cross and a flat 2-blade design that can easily blend and extract nutrients. It comes with 2 * 20 oz BPA-Free sport cups, 2 * party mugs, and 1 * 10 oz short cup, which can easily meet the needs of a family for making juices and smoothies.

【Healthy and Safe】Food blender is equipped with a safety lock that only works when the blender cup is properly locked into the base. Sip freely with the 20oz BPA-free blender cup. You can mash vegetables and fruits into delicious beverages with peace of mind.

【Reliable Quality Assurance】Syvio smoothie blender has 24-hour 100% satisfaction customer service. If you experience any issues with our items or services, please do not hesitate to contact us. Additionally, we provide a 12-month warranty and lifetime technical support to guarantee our reliable quality.
